policy.scope: Record source text, candidate, label, prediction, metric, dictionary/inventory, and outcome exposure that could affect development or an independence claim.
policy.unknown_rule: Unknown exposure is classified as exposed.
policy.append_only_rule: Do not delete an exposure. Correct it with a superseding record linked by supersedes_id.
policy.prohibited_contents: Do not place sealed source text, labels, participant data, credentials, or decryption material in this public ledger.
policy.public_actor_rule: Use role scopes rather than personal names in this public file. A custodian keeps any person-level access register outside the public repository under GOVERNANCE.md.
policy.final_item_rule: Every materialized project sealed-test item must have an item exposure record. A missing field, missing record, null state, or unverifiable access history is exposed_unknown and disqualifies that item from a new blinded-test claim.

records.actor_scope: project developers and readers of the committed profile/results
records.material: STREUSLE 5.0 projected VPC/VID splits, labels, counts, and transparent surface-baseline results
records.claim_effect: The projected test is external exposed evidence, not an untouched or project-sealed test; its Web-review domain is not the Wikipedia sampling population.
records.disposition: training, development, error analysis, and labeled smoke testing only

records.actor_scope: project developers and readers of the committed audit
records.material: Raganato-framework multiword-verb sense slice identities, gold-derived counts, limitations, and results inspected during construction
records.claim_effect: The 17 source-test rows are not blinded project evidence and the slice cannot establish target-wide, VID, take-in, ambiguity, abstention, or unseen-form validity.
records.disposition: external conditional sense-ranking smoke test only

records.actor_scope: project inventory developers and readers of committed projections/audits
records.material: OEWN 2025 form/sense candidates and bounded Wiktionary-derived VID mapping candidates
records.claim_effect: Dictionary exposure is allowed for inventory development but is not contextual gold and does not make future project occurrences label-exposed. It must still be disclosed for form-seen and model-input claims.
records.disposition: inventory-development evidence; never substitute for occurrence/category/sense gold

records.actor_scope: project material developers and readers of committed screens
records.material: Target-conditioned Simple English Wikipedia candidate queues, rendered boundaries, occurrence decisions, and provisional meaning/material selections
records.claim_effect: These target-conditioned rows and preliminary labels are exposed exploratory development evidence. The stopped SimpleWiki route cannot be relabeled as target-blind, prospectively sampled, or sealed evidence for the new English Wikipedia benchmark.
records.disposition: retain for detector/error analysis only; never enter the project sealed test

records.actor_scope: project material developers and readers of committed screens
records.material: VOA article metadata, bounded MWE lead profiles, recurrence decisions, and five-article occurrence/meaning desk review
records.claim_effect: The exhausted VOA material frame is exposed source-selection and occurrence-review evidence, not independent benchmark data or a population sample of English Wikipedia.
records.disposition: method and error-analysis history only; no passage or label enters the project sealed test

records.actor_scope: project rights/material reviewers and readers of committed metadata
records.material: TECO passage/token positions, machine MWE candidates, and preliminary single-project occurrence/category desk decisions
records.claim_effect: TECO source material and provisional labels are exposed and rights-restricted. They cannot form new project gold, sealed evidence, or a Web/API resource, and no gaze/proficiency/comprehension value validates the labels.
records.disposition: optional downstream rights clarification only; exclude from the first-paper core and runtime

records.actor_scope: project rights/material reviewers and readers of committed metadata
records.material: Project Gutenberg metadata frame, locally inspected notices/front matter/unit boundaries, and incidental target-string sightings
records.claim_effect: The stopped frame is not benchmark evidence. Boundary and rights inspection exposed some source material and four recorded target-string locations even though no target/MWE search or contextual classification was run.
records.disposition: preserve as failed-design and rights-method evidence; never represent it as unexposed or sealed

records.actor_scope: project evidence reviewers and readers of the committed admission audit
records.material: MAGPIE contexts, target spans, usage/idiomaticity labels, confidence distributions, and random/type-disjoint split metadata
records.claim_effect: MAGPIE is an exposed external secondary idiomaticity benchmark. It does not test open-text candidate recall, PARSEME VPC/VID category, or the new Wikipedia population and cannot become project-sealed gold.
records.disposition: external secondary idiomaticity development/comparison only with its own license and provenance

records.actor_scope: project evidence reviewers and readers of committed audits
records.material: MWEasWSD manual SemCor-derived rows, sense/not-MWE labels, candidate senses, conflicts, and mapped aggregate results
records.claim_effect: The artifact and its defects are exposed development evidence. Retrospective partitioning cannot create missing VPC/VID categories, independent labels, ambiguity states, document identities, or a sealed test.
records.disposition: external method/error analysis only; rejected as contextual fine-sense validation gold

records.actor_scope: project developers, repository readers, and automated tests
records.material: Project-authored synthetic scenarios, five MWE gold fixtures, transparent negative-control predictions, metric contributions, precision resamples, and their expected results
records.claim_effect: These public fixtures verify software behavior only and can never supply linguistic validity, independent agreement, or held-out performance.

records.actor_scope: AI-assisted protocol developers and readers of development metadata
records.material: Previously exposed SimpleWiki cached revisions registered before the IR136-SIMPLEWIKI-CONTRAST-1.0.0 target query for bounded contextual-contrast development
records.claim_effect: A verified cache and a newly frozen retrieval order do not erase the target-conditioned construction of this pool or its prior labels. The registered limits are budgets, not observed yields. No prevalence, linguistic gold, independent sense validation or sealed-test claim follows. Page-level rights remain separate and no text is released.
records.disposition: Extend the development purpose for this verified subset only to bounded contextual-contrast preparation under DEC-2026-09-05-020. Preserve the stopped Route 2 and all historical facts; all remaining material keeps its prior disposition and the entire pool stays excluded from the project sealed test.

records.actor_scope: AI-assisted protocol developer; not independent annotators
records.material: Prospectively registered fixed-window inspection of the 52-target, 51-document SimpleWiki development prefix under DEC-2026-09-05-020 and EXP-2026-09-05-011
records.claim_effect: This registers the whole fixed prefix before window results are opened; selected counts are not completed reviews or accepted examples. Contexts may be inspected only within same-section neighboring paragraphs, the 600-profile-token ceiling and the carried budget. Omitted blocks and other discontinuities cause holds; inline sup.reference citation markers are counted separately. Local desk observations are exposed AI development evidence, not gold, rights clearance or new model experiments.
records.disposition: Retain every first-lead slot, including errors, unreviewed items and holds; do not replace candidates or extend the source pool. Record source/window identities, viewed-paragraph unions, qualitative observations and elapsed inspection time internally without copying source prose. No publication, primary sampling or sealed-test use is authorized.

audit_coverage.method: Repository-evidence audit of committed benchmark profiles, admission audits, material screens, rights records, fixtures, and reported results through 2026-09-04.
classified_groups: STREUSLE occurrence/category gold and baseline results
Project Gutenberg boundary and incidental-string exposure
audit_coverage.outside_repository_boundary: Personal or unrecorded copies cannot be proven absent. If their access history later matters and cannot be verified, apply exposed_unknown rather than sealed.
audit_coverage.audit_result: All presently known project-relevant exposure groups are classified; no project sealed-test item exists.

final_item_exposure_schema.item_unit: One sealed-test document and all nested fragments/occurrences.
final_item_exposure_schema.classification: An item is eligible for a new blinded-test claim only when every applicable pre-score material/access field is sealed_verified and evidence-backed. Any exposed, exposed_unknown, missing, or null applicable field makes the item exposed.

model_experiment_register.rule: Append the inputs and full search range before execution. A missing or retrospectively expanded field makes the experiment exposed development evidence and ineligible as the primary locked system.
model_experiment_register.non_model_baseline_boundary: Existing deterministic surface and fixture baselines are already exposed in the records above; they are not contextual/probabilistic model experiments.

next_actions: Before split materialization, appoint the independent custodian required by resources/split_protocol.json.
Append every new material-access event, development experiment, and sealed artifact commitment before results are opened.
At materialization, require one final_item_exposure_schema record per sealed-test document and fail closed on any missing or unknown access history.
